https://github.com/10000ge10000/Summer-Tv/releases/latest/download/update.json  Summer TV\n\nA customized Android TV player based on open source TVBox projects. Distributed by sideloading; not published on any app store.\n\nContent notice: This app only provides player, playback control and configuration management. It does not produce, store, upload, transcode or distribute media. This build ships a default configuration containing third-party site and live-stream endpoints. Those services are neither operated nor endorsed by this project. This build always uses the bundled configuration; the app provides no configuration address entry.\n\nPrivacy: No third-party advertising, analytics, payment or push SDK is bundled, and no Advertising ID permission is requested. The app does include its own remote configuration, ad placement and anonymous analytics. Analytics is on by default and can be switched off at any time under About - Anonymous Analytics. While off, nothing is collected, queued or sent, and server-side configuration cannot override that. When on it reports app version, channel, device type, playback scene and a randomly generated install identifier (not a hardware serial; reset on reinstall). Turning it off again immediately clears any queue not yet sent. Source URLs, configuration addresses and raw search terms are not uploaded.\n\nDouban: the home Featured pick and poster wall request Douban public endpoints for trending lists, synopses and posters, without any account or device identifier.\n\nUpdates: on the home screen and when you tap About - Check for updates, the app reads the version file from this project\'s GitHub Releases (or its mirrors). It only notifies you; you download the installer in your browser and install it yourself. The app never downloads or installs packages on its own.\n\nTo rank playable sources first, the app records per-site and per-line start success, failures and start time on this device only; it is never uploaded.\n\nLocal data such as configuration, playback preferences, history, favourites, cache and crash logs stays on this device and is not uploaded automatically.\n\nOpen source: Based on CatVodTVOfficial/TVBoxOSC and takagen99/Box, licensed under AGPL-3.0. Recipients of this build are entitled to the corresponding complete source code. See LICENSE and NOTICE.md. Version: v%1$s
